notes: The owner's first real Test press against his Openfire ran the whole corrected path — plain connect, ready for STARTTLS — and failed with the GENERIC network_unreachable sentence and no detail. The socket's actual error was captured and CLOBBERED ONE EVENT LATER. Node emits error then close on a failed socket. The lifecycle treated the close as a fresh failure: the stop was re-recorded with a null detail — overwriting ECONNREFUSED, or self-signed certificate, or whatever the socket actually said — and the failure count moved twice per attempt, skewing the backoff.
